confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregator and crowdsourced cost-of-living sites that disagree and carry dated or mixed-city figures; Laos has high inflation, so older guides may understate current prices. Beer and coffee are cross-checked across sources; inexpensive and midrange meals are moderately supported; cocktail and wine have no Vang Vieng price found and are derived from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2.3x beer, wine about 3x beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Vang Vieng context, with no accommodation search or live listing check. FX is the RBA 4pm observation for 18 Nov 2026 as reported in RBA-sourced search results; the RBA page itself was not opened directly, and intraday market quotes for 19 Nov were excluded.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against small backpacker-oriented tourist towns in northern Laos such as Luang Prabang, adjusted down for local-venue food and beer and up for tourist-facing bars and riverside hotels. Vientiane figures were used only as a sanity check, not as a direct basis.
